mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.2 percentage point decline in unemployment rate over three months signals strengthening labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE declines by over 0.2pp in three months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer demand, accelerating corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST exceed their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production rising above its 6-month moving average signals manufacturing expansion, increasing corporate profit visibility and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO remains above its 6-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL monthly inflation exceeding 0.2% signals rising price pressures, prompting Federal Reserve tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Payrolls growth above the 12-month average indicates sustained labor market strength, supporting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds its 12-month average.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1,000,000 units (1000.0 in thousands) signals a robust housing market, acting as a leading indicator for economic expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1000.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent acceleration in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates broad economic expansion, increasing corporate earnings visibility and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 exceed their 3-month moving averages.
